fields.note: Local buckling keeps gamma = 1 at r/t 140.5. NASA SP-8007, the source 011 cites for the 0.6, gives gamma = 1-0.901*(1-exp(-sqrt(r/t)/16)) = 0.529. Local at the card's SiC point is then 0.648. Re-optimised with gamma, SiC on the equilateral grid at k 0.2 is 1.075 (r/t 94), two-way is 0.967, and with FIX-A as well 1.205 and 1.083. At 100 kg systems and a 5% margin these are 1.130 and 1.015.
fields.fix: FIX-B: apply SP-8007's gamma to the local mode and re-optimise.
